news.headline: Travellers in UK face ongoing disruption after air traffic control glitch
news.summary: Flights from British airports began to resume Wednesday after a glitch in the country's air traffic control service left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded. Authorities warned that travellers would continue to experience delays as airlines scrambled to recover from the outage.
